# How to use this handbook

The handbook follows the curriculum sequence. Each chapter explains the idea, shows the relevant circuit or block diagram, identifies formulas and units, and gives a short GUESS example or engineering check. Use the separate two-page quick reference during assignments and tests.

The diagrams show concepts and classroom-scale circuits. Confirm actual component data, logic voltage, current limits, pinout, polarity, and safety requirements before building.
